title: Ready to Translate, Not to Represent? Bias and Performance Gaps in Multilingual LLMs Across Language Families and Domains
reasoning: The paper includes 'Religious bias' as one of the six primary categories for its benchmarking framework. It provides a formal definition for this category, a dedicated list of religious keywords used for detection (including terms like 'quran', 'bible', 'allah', and 'temple'), and evaluates models specifically on their propensity to introduce religious bias into translations.
